queuePolicy.admissionInstruction: Only tasks in the tasks array are prepared Product execution cards. Root sets the current activationId after review of this concrete card; the controller then waits for N84 awaiting_po/closed. Do not auto-admit blocked, study-only or external-artifact rows. queuePolicy.dependencySemantics: dependsOn accepts a task ID or Product ID whose runtime status is awaiting_po or closed. PO review itself does not reserve a worker or delivery lane. A blocked dependency holds only dependent cards; unrelated cards continue.
queuePolicy.stopScope: A missing capability, material affected-check failure or ambiguous Product contract parks only that card with a named condition and preserves the candidate. Never mark a required gate PASS from a Demo or an unavailable service.
queuePolicy.quotaPolicy: Keep the existing controller usage-pause/resume behavior, finite runtime budgets, bounded same-blocker retries and saved Codex sessions. No paid API fallback, unlimited-use assumption, repeated planning worker or continuous re-study. Change a dependencyblocked classification only when new concrete evidence arrives.
queuePolicy.whenCatalogExhausts: Emit the remaining named capability/policy blockers and explicit no-eligible-ready-work state. Do not manufacture cosmetic/doc/umbrella-closing cards to keep workers busy, reopen deferred work, or label the factory productive while no eligible work is running.
queuePolicy.closurePolicy: Product IDs remain independent and OPEN until their actual acceptance contract is satisfied. A scoped implementation, private artifact, local study or hosted Demo does not close its umbrella ticket. Production delivery enters awaiting_po and releases capacity.

tasks.objective: After N84 is deployed/awaiting PO, implement the approved N94 subitem dates and persisted late-scoring behavior on fresh current main in actual Product items/Gradebook. Begin by tracing scoreSubitems and scoreSubitemCompletions through the existing db/store, outbox/Sync normalizers and Backup/Restore paths; the known consumers are listed in allowedPaths. Reuse the existing ordinary value as regularPoints compatibility instead of silently creating a competing maximum. Preserve existing records and owner contracts. Store immutable automatic createdAt separately from optional teacher startDate; an empty startDate means immediate start, and a supplied dueDate cannot precede a supplied startDate. dueDate is optional, and optional latePoints defaults to ordinary points and stays within the existing lower bound through regularPoints. After the app's existing local-date due boundary, deliberate taps cycle unrecorded -> late -> regular/accepted excuse -> unrecorded. Before that boundary or with no dueDate, retain unrecorded <-> regular. Persist the teacher's selected state per student/subitem; time passage, timezone/device-clock change, due-date edits or grade recalculation must not silently reinterpret an existing record. A late click is a teacher-selected label, not proof of actual submittedAt. Display calm distinct gray/amber/green states with text and symbols, plus the actual points even when regular and late points are equal. Preserve N84 Quick Log controls and existing automatic/manual/attendance score semantics. Return LOCAL_READY only after every named required check establishes actual Product-path behavior and release scope; if backend field support, ownership, Sync or restore cannot be established without new server work/authority, return BLOCKED naming that exact condition and preserve the candidate. No mock-server success, Demo-only branch or unchanged code disguised as completion.
